description: SYNTHETIC fixtures for the F2 prose guard. They replace 32 verbatim fragments of real sermons captured from live sessions, which had no place in a published repository. Generated and self-verified by tools/s12/generate_f2_fixtures.py: every entry matches the F2 comma-list pattern (dropped with the guard off) and reproduces its declared behaviour with the guard on. The metric range and the threshold boundary are preserved on purpose - the fixtures calibrate F2_PROSE_GUARD_MIN_MEAN_WORDS (2.5), so a set that ignored the numbers would leave the test green while proving nothing.
